disposition.rationale: PNG alpha and color-profile umbrella facets: 2,808 reference crossings of every accepted signal family (gray and RGB ICC v2/v4 matrix and LUT, gAMA, cHRM, the sRGB chunk, SDR/linear/BT.709/Display-P3 and ignored narrow-range cICP, PQ/HLG) with every sample layout, transparency form (intrinsic, key, palette, none), interlace and APNG container, in SVG, PNG and PDF. They cover the PDF grayscale soft mask, exact alpha and transparent RGB zero. Per-family precedence and unsupported classes are enumerated by the owned codec:png:color/icc/cicp rows. This replaces the earlier equivalence argument with vectors. See docs/research/png-umbrella-facets.md.

Reviewed full-width grayscale/RGB transparency-key contract: endpoint/asymmetric keys, exact and same-high-byte near matches including each RGB channel; pinned official PNG, independent PDF samples/masks, untouched SVG and complete silent repeated facade outcomes. Valid 16-bit tRNS components cannot encode out-of-range numeric keys; lower-depth range and malformed-length cases remain the malformed palette/tRNS obligation. See docs/research/png-precision-ownership.md#transparency-key-range-applicability.

See docs/research/png-precision-ownership.md.
